name: 044.2 — both anchors, and the collection
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 044.2: hafen.vr():widget() takes both anchors — :add(w, p) stands a widget at a point and carries :position(p, a), :add(w, gob) makes it follow that object and die with it — both are ordinary members of the collection and of hafen.vr():list(), and the title-bar drag is inert on either.
